disorder-name.detail: Antipsychotic-naive patients with first-episode psychosis enrolled in a 16-week risperidone trial at the University of Alabama at Birmingham. Diagnoses include schizophrenia (49%), schizoaffective disorder (17.3%), schizophreniform disorder (6.1%), brief psychotic disorder (4.1%), bipolar disorder with psychosis (4.1%), major depression with psychosis (3.1%), and unspecified psychosis (16.3%). Normative model applied to the cohort as a whole (n=98).
disorder-name.supporting_text: "patients with first-episode psychosis who were naive to antipsychotic medication"
